optimizedContext.value:
# Language Adapter

## Rules
- `LanguageAdapter` is stateless synchronous deterministic interface: `languages()`, `extensions()`, `resolutionManifests()`, `analyzeFile`, `resolveImports`, `buildRelations`; optional package/qualified-path helpers.
- `resolutionManifests()` returns exact basenames without I/O/globs/paths; TypeScript returns `["package.json"]`.
- `analyzeFile(filePath,content,context)` parses once and emits complete compact `FileAnalysisDraft`: symbols, imports, scopes, bindings, calls, references, namespace, optional serializable parser state. No legacy extraction or retained AST.
- Pass 2 consumes stored facts+`IndexSession`; no content reread, whole-symbol scan, or per-candidate filesystem probe. Emit only deterministic dependency/hierarchy relations; `DEPENDS_ON` remains spec-only.
- Registry dynamically maps registered languages/extensions; built-ins compose through providers, TypeScript default. Unknown extension skips without `FileNode`; generic pipeline has no language branches.
- Import facts carry local/original names, specifier, relative flag, form. Syntax parsed only during analysis; adapter resolves later using session/package/qualified maps.
- Extract lexical scopes, typed params/properties, construction, receivers, aliases, referenced types, deterministic registry framework bindings. Shared pipeline owns scope/shadowing/candidate filtering.
- Calls use innermost callable caller and proven local/import/receiver/session callee. Drop top-level, global, ambiguous, dynamic, runtime/reflection/container/monkey-patch/interprocedural cases.
- Built-in TS/JS, Python, Go, PHP satisfy common analysis, reference, range, coverage, capability contracts; language-specific specs define exact semantics. Generic code never compensates for missing facts.
- Capabilities truthful only when shared facts+ordered provenance prove declarations/members/bindings/hierarchy/build context; missing support records coverage.
- Member-capable adapter derives logical owner before member identity, emits `MemberSemantics`, and assigns lexical occurrence `parentId` with strict scope popping. Top-level has no owner; indexer never recomputes by language list.
- Parse human/native member refs into explicit structured owner→member candidates; canonical/structured inputs bypass parsing. Shared domain never splits `.`; ambiguous/dynamic remains unresolved. Render generic plus optional native spelling.
- Hierarchy support emits consistent facts/provenance and `EXTENDS`/`IMPLEMENTS`/`OVERRIDES`; supported resolvable syntax without evidence violates capability; unsupported alternatives record gap.
- Every symbol has parser-derived half-open full construct range and contained exact `selectionRange`; omit untrustworthy candidates and report gap.
- Package identity walks from `codeRoot` to bounded repo root: TS `package.json.name`; Python `[project].name`; Go `go.mod module`; PHP `composer.json.name`. Declared manifests match files actually read.
- Only package identity and optional qualified-name helper may perform I/O; Pass 2 qualified metadata comes from compact analysis/session cache.
- Re-exports resolve one indexed entry through relative path or package public map. Binding surface is re-exporting file; `targetId` is published logical symbol, including cross-workspace. Preserve each route; never select first same-name symbol. Indexer persists facts but owns no package/re-export rules.
- Dynamic file/load expressions without literal deterministic target drop silently. Tree-sitter/ast-grep queries remain private implementation.

## Constraints
- Interface, not abstract class; analysis/resolution/relation methods synchronous deterministic.
- Plain compact state only; no side effects outside session.
- No fuzzy/runtime inference or `@specd/core` dependency.
- Filesystem I/O prohibited except declared optional helpers; no Pass 2 per-candidate probing.
- Adapter owns language semantics; indexer owns none.
